sample_unit: patients (six public benchmarks spanning 798 rare diseases; plus 511 patients in two real-world IPF cohorts)
unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to generate schema-guided knowledge profiles (knowledge layer) rather than for end-to-end patient-level diagnosis
Systematic quality assessment of LLM-generated knowledge before use
Local deployment of computable knowledge base with lightweight inference pipelines

screen.reason: Evaluates a novel framework (GEN-KnowRD) using LLMs to build a rare disease knowledge base for diagnosis/screening across public benchmarks and retrospective EHR cohorts; focuses on architecture and model accuracy rather than evaluating a specific health care organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
